search.prompt:
Lead search request (combine all lines into ONE search):
- Earlier: Find 20 leads for Agit.fit (https://agit.fit/). About Agit.fit: we provide high-quality synthetic human-motion datasets for AI and computer vision teams: 3D human pose, depth maps, segmentation, body keypoints, exercise movements and common exercise-form errors, so companies can train AI models without relying only on expensive real-world data collection and manual annotation. Goal: decision-makers at companies that could buy synthetic human-motion training data. Target industries: AI-powered fitness technology; computer vision and human pose estimation; digital health and remote physiotherapy; rehabilitation and musculoskeletal (MSK) technology; sports technology and movement analysis; biomechanics and motion tracking; AI research companies working on 3D human motion; robotics or AR/VR companies that need human-motion datasets. Target job titles: Founder, Co-Founder, CEO, CTO, VP of Engineering, Head of AI, Head of Machine Learning, Director of Computer Vision, Head of Data Science, AI Research Lead, Director of R&D, ML Engineering Manager. Filters: United States; company size 11-200 employees; verified business email. Company keywords: AI fitness, computer vision, human pose estimation, motion tracking, synthetic data, 3D human pose, movement analysis, digital physiotherapy, rehabilitation technology, biomechanics, sports AI, exercise form correction. Rules: prioritize companies that build their own AI or computer-vision products involving human movement (rep counting, exercise-form correction, movement assessment, pose estimation, rehabilitation). Avoid ordinary gyms, personal trainers, fitness influencers, unrelated healthcare providers, and companies with no clear link to AI or motion data. If fewer than 20 qualified leads exist, return only the relevant ones.
- Latest refinement: As described in my request above — 20 leads
Use the latest refinement to update industry, titles, location, and needs. Keep the full meaning.
